summary: Join our Coaching for Performance Improvement Course to elevate your performance. Gain valuable insights and strategies for personal and professional growth.
lede: Performance Coaching for Organizational Growth gives leaders a practical way to make performance conversations support meaningful development. You’ll learn to use structured one-to-one coaching, measurable goals, and accountability practices to help people take greater ownership of their progress. Through case studies, simulations, and established coaching models, you’ll build feedback habits that sustain motivation and strengthen leadership impact. The tools and strategies are designed for immediate application in everyday management conversations.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals leading people, projects, or teams who want to drive measurable growth. Whether you are in the corporate sector, public sector, or an NGO, this training will elevate your leadership and coaching skills.
modules: The GROW and CLEAR Coaching Models
prerequisites: Participants should have experience in managing teams or projects. Familiarity with basic leadership principles is recommended.
